title: Approved Document M volume 2 (passenger lifts)
edition: Approved Document M volume 2, 2015 incorporating 2020 amendments
notes: A 900 mm wide route may stand in for the 1500 × 1500 mm landing (not checked yet).

accessible_cars.description: Car at least 1100 mm wide by 1400 mm deep, doors at least 800 mm clear

landing.description: 1500 × 1500 mm clear landing in front of each lift entrance

call_buttons.description: Landing call buttons 900–1100 mm above the floor

stairlift.description: A wheelchair platform stairlift has a platform of at least 800 × 1250 mm and runs at most 0.15 m/s; the escape stair keeps its clear width with the unit parked (800 mm for a stair serving up to 50 people, as makers restate Approved Document B). Rails guiding a stairlift are left out of the width. A 1500 × 1500 mm clear landing in front of each lifting device.
